builds.name: Immortal Princess
builds.desc: The intent of this build is to make Lissa a pseudo healer/tank. Due to Lissa's default bulk she can generally take a hit and live, providing the chance for her to counter attack with absorb+ healing back the damage that she had taken. If used on player's turn Absorb+ can also heal nearby allies. Martyr+ is used to heal herself and allied units. Miracle provides extra survivability. Close Counter allows her to counter and tank melee units. Quick riposte will allow her to double attack when she is attacked and synergies well with absorb+, this makes her perform well in the enemy phase. Threaten Res and Attack +3 Seal will increases her damage and thus increases her self heal from absorb+ giving her more damage and sustainability. Her balance defenses works in favor of this build allowing her to take on both physical and magical enemies. She benefits greatly from buffs such as drive attack, blessings, or if you pick her as your summoner support. Due to her availability she is also easier to merge, improving on her tanking role.
